items.name: Orbital Sword
items.description: A medium blade orbits the fighter and strikes at close range.

items.name: Bow
items.description: Fires an aimed arrow every 1.5 seconds.

items.name: Heavy Pistol
items.description: One heavy round. Slow fire rate, massive damage.

items.name: Minelayer
items.description: Drops a compact mine every 5 seconds. Explodes in a small area.

items.name: Scattergun
items.description: Fires three pellets in a spread every 3 seconds.

items.name: Long Spear
items.description: A light spear with longer reach and a slower orbit.

items.name: Orbit Hammer
items.description: A heavy hammer that can knock fighters into a wall stun.

items.name: Orbit Dagger
items.description: A short, light blade that circles extremely fast.

items.name: Orbit Shield
items.description: A slow shield that deflects projectiles and other melee weapons. Mines and wall spikes ignore it.

items.name: Poison Dart
items.description: Deals exactly 1 damage on hit, then adds 1 poison damage per second until the round ends.

items.name: Shuriken
items.description: Throws every 2 seconds. A hit shortens its next throw by 1 second.

items.name: Orbit Katana
items.description: A long light blade with Spear damage and a 50% chance to deflect a projectile at the enemy.

items.name: Orbit Scythe
items.description: A long medium scythe with Katana speed. Each hit deals 15 damage and restores 10 HP.

items.name: Pied Piper Flute
items.description: Every 8 seconds, calls five 1-HP mice from behind the fighter. Each mouse bites the enemy for 5 damage and remains until defeated or the round ends.

items.name: Bouncy Ball
items.description: Throws one very fast 7-damage ball every 3 seconds. It ricochets at natural angles until it naturally returns; a shield or Katana changes its colour and sends one hit back at its prior holder.

items.name: Boomerang
items.description: Throws a slowly spinning boomerang every 4 seconds. Wall impacts redirect it toward its owner while a gentle pull curves it back.

items.name: Spiked Rebounds
items.description: Every wall bounce leaves a temporary spike.

items.name: Spiked Skin
items.description: Grows spikes around the fighter. Direct fighter contact deals 10 damage instead of the normal 2.

items.name: Dash
items.description: Accelerates toward the opponent every 4 seconds.

items.name: Dodge
items.description: Sidesteps nearby incoming projectiles with brief invulnerability.

items.name: Regeneration
items.description: Restores 5 health every 4 seconds.

items.name: Pulse Shield
items.description: Periodically generates a damage-absorbing shield.

items.name: Lifesteal
items.description: Heals for a portion of damage dealt.

items.name: Lucky
items.description: 60% chance to avoid placed hazards, slowing tape, and Bouncy Ball hits, plus 10% chance to dodge other ranged attacks.

items.name: Slowing Tape
items.description: Starts at a 15% wall-bounce chance, rising by 1% after each miss. It remains until crossed, then slows an enemy to 20% speed for 3 seconds.

items.name: Damage Field
items.description: Draws a transparent team-colour line between wall bounces. When three or more lines close a shape, enemies inside take 25 damage. The next wall bounce starts a new field.

items.name: Pocket Minion
items.description: Brings a small 40-HP helper with one random weapon.

items.name: Double Health
items.description: Health x2.

items.name: Endurance
items.description: Health ×1.4.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.description: Health ×0.7, damage ×1.5.

items.name: Speedster
items.description: Speed ×1.4.

items.name: Slowpoke
items.description: Speed ×0.75.

items.name: Small Target
items.description: Radius ×0.7. Harder to hit.

items.name: Big Ball
items.description: Radius ×1.4. More mass, a bigger target.

items.name: Armor
items.description: Reduces incoming damage by 20%.

items.name: Power Up
items.description: All weapon damage ×1.25.

items.name: Berserk
items.description: Below 20% health, all damage is doubled.

items.name: Crit Striker
items.description: 20% chance for an attack to deal double damage. Poison ticks can also crit.

items.name: Slow Swings
items.description: Melee weapons rotate 30% slower.

items.name: Faster Swings
items.description: Doubles the rotation speed of all melee weapons.

items.name: Slow Reload
items.description: Adds 1 second to every weapon reload.

items.name: Fast Reload
items.description: Reduces every weapon reload by 35%.

items.name: Bad Aim
items.description: Each shot picks a random aim offset from -5 to +5 degrees.

items.name: Combo Master
items.description: A hit within 2.5 seconds of your last hit deals 30% more damage. Poison is excluded.
